detaileddescription.para: Every object with an inspector property receives this inspector. Items among them are stacked in declaration order above the other children of the plot's overlay.

briefdescription.para: Plot whose series are inspected.
Enables queries. A disabled inspector is inactive and does no work. Default: true.
NearestX and NearestY report each series at the cursor's X or Y; NearestXY picks by on-screen distance. Default: NearestX.
Pick distance in logical pixels. In NearestX and NearestY mode it only limits matches beyond a series' extreme samples. Default: 16.
Moves the crosshair to the closest matching sample. Default: false.
In NearestX and NearestY mode, reports the point on the line between two consecutive samples instead of the nearer one. Default: false.
Adds Y statistics of the samples around the cursor to every row. Default: false.
Half-width of the summary neighborhood in logical pixels. Default: 0.5.
Series to inspect; an empty list inspects every series of the plot.

Whether the cursor follows the plot's pointer. When false it stays at cursorX and cursorY. Default: true.

detaileddescription.para: The cursor follows the plot's pointer by default; set followPointer to false and write cursorX to drive it from code, for example to link the crosshairs of several plots. Results are refreshed at most once per event-loop pass.
In QML, declare Crosshair, InspectionMarkers, and InspectionTooltip inside the inspector: they receive it as their inspector and are stacked in declaration order, the last one on top.
